subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Allay
solution: The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. Relieve.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Allay **means 'to make something less strong'/lessen the intensity of or calm.' ((पीड़ा, कष्‍ट, भय आदि की) तीव्रता या प्रबलता कम करना) • **For Example:** • ​*The government is trying to **allay **public fears about the spread of the disease.* • *​​***Relieve **means to make an unpleasant feeling or situation stop or get better. (कष्‍ट या चिंता में राहत पहुँचाना) • **For Example:** • **​***This injection should **relieve **the pain.* • *​*It is clear that **Allay** and **Relieve** is similar in meaning. • Hence the correct answer is **option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Release **means to allow somebody/something to be free.(व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को (किसी से या कहीं से) मुक्त करना, जाने देना) • **Arrange **means to put something in order or in a particular pattern.(व्‍यवस्थित करना, क्रम विशेष से सजाना) • **Allure **means the quality of being attractive and exciting.(प्रलोभन, आकर्षण) 38:T628, The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. I cannot understand anything.**
